# Goals’ filters and sort

One definition of what each filter and sort means (`src/domain/query.ts`), used by the Goals screen in every layout, by exports, saved views and shared links (as the address’s query string), by Home’s and the habit panel’s links into Goals, by Find’s goals ([finding things](rules/finding.md)), and by the AI tools’ `find_goals`. A link holds only what differs from no filter, in one fixed order, so equal queries make equal links.

## Each filter, and how a link writes it

Each field of the query with the parameter the code writes for it (the example values are the code’s own, set one at a time), and what the field means in the comment written beside it. Several values of one filter are joined with commas and mean any of them; different filters all apply.

| Field | In the address | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `q` | `q=lead time` | Words that must all appear in the goal's title, owner, team, level, reason, recovery plan or definition. |
| `status` | `status=off,risk` | Goals with any of these statuses (the status this week, with No check-in yet and Not started). |
| `level` | `level=team` | Goals at any of these levels, by the level's id. |
| `team` | `team=cicd` | Goals of any of these teams, by the team's id. |
| `owner` | `owner=-me` | Owners by id; `-me` (NOT_ME) means "not the person asking" (Home rule 4, HM3), said as "Owner: not you". |
| `kind` | `kind=metric` | Goals of any of these kinds: move a number, keep in range, dated stages. |
| `attention` | `attention=1` | Only the goals on the Needs attention list (those being handled with them, grouped below): the same rule as Home, Watching, the map, reviews and the AI (domain/attention.ts). |
| `needs` | `attention=1` `needs=no-path` | …and only because of one of these (empty: for any reason). |
| `due` | `due=quarter` | Due by the end of this quarter, or by a given week. |
| `quiet` | `quiet=2` | No update for at least this many weeks: the stale rule's days since the latest check-in was posted, in weeks. |
| `quarter` | `qtr=missed` | How the last closed quarter went. |
| `result` | `result=late` | Goals whose result, once it is due, is any of these: met, met late, not met, or not finished yet. |
| `feeds` | `feeds=ns-lead` | Only this goal and the goals that feed it, all the way down. |
| `helps` | `helps=1` | Only goals with a dotted "also helps" line, to or from them. |
| `sort` | `sort=gap` | The order (SORT_OPTIONS); none keeps the order the goals were given in. |
| `dir` | `sort=gap.desc` | 1: the natural order for the key (worst first, A to Z, oldest check-in first, soonest due); -1 reverses it. |
| `cols` | `metric=lead-time` | A module's filters (docs/design/architecture.md, 4.2): its parameter in the address and the value picked, compared with the column the module fills for each goal (QueryContext.columns). Measured by a metric: `{ metric: <id> }`. |
| `checkedin` | `checkedin=no` | This week's check-in (habit spec 1; HM7, HB2): `no`, due and not checked in yet; `asked`, checked in after an ask for an update. Only goals due this week match either. |
| `inreview` | `inreview=weekly` | Only the goals a review walks (its id): the habit panel's links (HB2). An unknown review matches nothing. |
| `moved` | `moved=worse` | What changed since a day (Home rule 5, HM4): `worse`, `better`, `quiet`, `done` or `any`, as written. The rule, its words and which kinds it knows are changed.ts's, through the context (`moved`) and the names: so none of it is in Home's first download. A kind it doesn't know is no filter. |
| `since` | `since=2026-11-06` | The day `moved` counts from (yyyy-mm-dd); left out: this week's Monday. |

Every parameter a query reads, in the order a link writes them: `q`, `status`, `level`, `team`, `owner`, `kind`, `attention`, `needs`, `moved`, `since`, `due`, `quiet`, `qtr`, `result`, `feeds`, `helps`, `checkedin`, `inreview`, `sort`, `metric`. The last are modules’ own: a module filters by the column it fills for each goal (`metric=` for Measured by), and a switched-off module’s parameter narrows nothing. An unknown value is no filter.

## The values each filter takes, and their words

- **Status (`status`):** `off` “Off track”, `risk` “At risk”, `stale` “No recent update”, `on` “On track”, `done` “Done”, `none` “No check-in yet”, `planned` “Not started”, `unmeasured` “Not measured yet”
- **Needs attention because (`needs`, with `attention=1`):** `off` “Off track”, `missed-path` “Missed its own date”, `stale` “No recent update”, `decision` “Decision or help needed”, `no-path` “No path to green”, `risk` “At risk”, `trend` “Getting worse”, `greener` “Greener than calculated”, `slipped` “Date slipped”
- **Result (`result`):** `completed` “Met”, `late` “Met late”, `missed` “Not met”, `open` “Not finished yet”
- **Kind (`kind`):** `metric` “Move a number”, `range` “Keep in range”, `milestone` “Dated stages”
- **Sort (`sort`):** `worst` “Worst first”, `title` “Name”, `owner` “Owner”, `team` “Team”, `level` “Level”, `gap` “Furthest from plan”, `last` “Longest since a check-in”, `due` “Due soonest”
- **Owner:** a person’s id, or `-me` for “Owner: not you” (the goals someone else owns).
- **Due:** `quarter` (by the end of this quarter) or a week’s number (by that week).

## The order

**Worst first** (`sort=worst`, and Find’s goals unless sorted) is by the status’s rank, worst first: Off track, then At risk, No recent update (equal), then On track, then Done, Not started, No check-in yet, Not measured yet (equal); then by title A to Z, ignoring case. With another `sort`, its natural order (A to Z, the longest since a check-in first, the soonest due first, the furthest behind plan first), `.desc` reversing it (`sort=gap.desc`), and ties worst first, then by title. With no `sort` the query keeps the order it is given: the screens give goals worst first by how much each needs attention (its worst flag, [the flags](rules/flags.md)), then the status’s rank, then the title (`worstFirst`, `src/domain/order.ts`).
